title: 세탁소에서 요청 설명하기: 얼룩이 묻은 듯해요
objective: Explain a clothing problem using -(으)ㄴ/는/(으)ㄹ 듯해요.
summary: Describe a stain and ask for an alteration at a dry cleaner.
setting: A neighborhood dry cleaner (세탁소). A customer drops off a coat with a stain and pants to be shortened.

task.title: Describe and request
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to answer each item in Korean.

words.meaning: to leave (an item) with a shop for service
words.exampleMeaning: I left my shirts at the dry cleaner on my way home from work.
I got a kimchi juice stain on my white shirt.

words.meaning: to get on (something), to be stained with
words.example: 비 오는 날 바지에 흙이 묻었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Mud got on my pants on a rainy day.
I washed it with detergent, but the stain won't come out.
The waist is too big, so I want to take it in a little.
The skirt is long, so it keeps dragging on the stairs.

dialogue.meaning: Welcome. What would you like to leave with us?

dialogue.korean: 이 코트 드라이클리닝 해 주세요. 소매에 얼룩이 있는데, 기름이 묻은 듯해요.
dialogue.meaning: Please dry-clean this coat. There's a stain on the sleeve. It looks like some oil got on it.

dialogue.korean: 아, 기름 얼룩 맞네요. 오래된 얼룩은 완전히 안 빠질 수도 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Ah, yes, it's an oil stain. Old stains might not come out completely.

dialogue.korean: 지난주에 묻은 거예요. 그리고 이 바지는 길이를 좀 줄이고 싶어요.
dialogue.meaning: It got on there last week. And I'd like to have these pants shortened a little.
How much should we shorten them?

dialogue.korean: 신발을 신으면 바닥에 끌리는 듯해서요. 한 2센티 정도요.
dialogue.meaning: When I wear shoes, they seem to drag on the floor. About 2 cm.

exercises: Choose the form that matches the English 'It looks like my perm has already come loose': 파마가 벌써 (풀린 / 풀릴) 듯해요.
Complete with the verb in brackets + 듯해요: ① (what you see now) 앞머리가 눈을 ____ 듯해요. (가리다) ② (a guess about the future result) 지금 보니 이 얼룩은 앞으로도 잘 안 ____ 듯해요. (빠지다)
You want the sleeves of your jacket made shorter. Which do you say? (a) 소매를 좀 줄여 주세요. (b) 소매를 좀 맡겨 주세요.
Choose the right word: 하얀 블라우스에 와인이 (묻었어요 / 빠졌어요). 지워 주실 수 있어요?
Answer in Korean from the dialogue: 손님은 왜 바지 길이를 줄이고 싶어 해요?
answers: 신발을 신으면 바닥에 끌리는 듯해서요. (신발을 신으면 바지가 바닥에 끌려서요.)
